motto: Every light is counted. Every counter is counted too.
philosophy: The Undervillage keeps the lights Hollyhollow stopped noticing: old lanterns, retired names, promises that outlived their keepers. It is not hostile — but it does not wish to be found, and it will test anyone who knocks.

night_porter.name: Night Porter
night_porter.defeat: "Fine. The Lamplighter hasn't been seen since the last count. Happy?"

lantern_thief.name: Lantern Thief
lantern_thief.defeat: "The lanterns don't belong to the festival. They belong underneath."

registry_clerk.name: Registry Clerk
registry_clerk.intro: "You are not on the list. I keep the list. Do you see the problem?"
registry_clerk.defeat: "...You have been added to the list. Welcome, I suppose."

lamplighter_apprentice.name: Apprentice Wren
lamplighter_apprentice.intro: "You knocked. Nobody knocks. Prove you should have."
lamplighter_apprentice.defeat: "...You knock like a keeper. Fine. The well. After dark."

undervillage_curator.name: The Curator
undervillage_curator.intro: "You want the Lamplighter. The Lamplighter wants to stay. Convince me otherwise."
undervillage_curator.defeat: "...Then take the wick. The village above will need a new keeper of uncounted lights someday. Perhaps it is you."

boss_mechanic.name: Lantern Veil
boss_mechanic.description: At half health the Curator dims every lantern in the Undervillage at once: its team gains Speed and critical-hit chance while the light — and your accuracy — fails.
